rules: pool: y0*dX*fee >= T*(x0*1000 + dX*fee) (ErgoDEX v1 n2t Pool.sc:56-60)
grid (bid, var 0 = false): units added > 0 and units * R5[1] >= ERG taken; successor at OUTPUTS(var 1) with R4, R5 copied, R6 = SELF.id, same script and token
